description: Elegant local consultancy website with services and a contact form on laptop and smartphone.

Primary request: premium realistic laptop and smartphone product photography showing a small elegant local consultancy business website, ONLY services and a contact form.

A slim silver laptop is open in a three-quarter view and a smartphone lies slightly upright on a small real stand near its left front corner, each fully grounded on the desk. The laptop is the clear main subject.

Wide calm header, a refined editorial serif headline, a simple architectural abstract photo, three clear service cards, and a contact section. The phone shows a short contact form. No booking calendar, appointment system, account, client dashboard, prices, payment interface, invented metrics, awards, ratings, dense copy, watermarks, extra text outside the screens, floating objects or magical visual effects.
